Frontier: S057 (man7.org ld.so(8)) row + Gate; census 56 -> 57 (A 54, C 3; mined 46), exit 0.

Every item names what it attacks. Bounds: absolute paths under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin; clone to /tmp/kama-r19f-<Name> (cp -a); never edit the lane, its git/jj state/index, the fleet repo, siblings, config/state, MANIFEST/scripts/templates. No pacman or host service/boot action (pacman paused); no persistent servers; only the counters ephemeral loopback fakes, none left running. Never agent://all. Every claim needs an executed command and observed exit; mark unexecuted reasoning [INFERENCE]. Keep a receipt in your OUT dir.
Every Report: trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin - write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/<that path>. First line VERDICT: confirm|partial|refute - ... Routing is host-owned: never pass or name a model.
